scope: New EPUB presentation and navigation only; no translation source wording changed.
review_policy: All choices remain open to correction; expert response is not a release gate.

choices.choice: نص المنطق المفتوح — فصل المجموعات — الترميز الدولي / الترميز المشرقي
choices.evidence: source/locale/ar/open-logic-locale.sty defines OLT as نص المنطق المفتوح; source/locale/ar/content/sets-functions-relations/sets/sets.tex defines the chapter as المجموعات; the existing repository README distinguishes international and Machrek notation.
choices.rationale: Identify the actual bounded chapter and notation profile; do not reuse the complete-book title or imply full722 coverage.
choices.confidence: High editorial confidence from direct existing edition labels, not a calibrated probability.

choices.choice: يشمل هذا الملف فصل المجموعات بأقسامه الستة ومقدمة المشروع. وليس نسخة كاملة من الكتاب ذي الوحدات الـ722.
choices.evidence: SOURCE_FREEZE.json selects introduction OLP-0001, routing-only OLP-0004, and six sections OLP-0005–OLP-0010; excludes714 other units.
choices.rationale: New factual editorial notice, not translated mathematical prose. It makes the partial overall scope prominent in Arabic and English.
choices.canon_limit: No historical Arabic attestation is claimed for this newly composed administrative notice.
choices.confidence: High factual scope confidence; prose remains editorial and open to expert stylistic improvement.

choices.rationale: Literal navigational labels describing the contents list and provenance/scope page. These are administrative additions, not new mathematical terminology.
choices.canon_limit: No dictionary attestation claimed; an expert may prefer alternative navigation phrasing.

choices.where: Formal-object headings, figures, and internal reference links
choices.choice: Preserve existing Arabic locale names; use consistent chapter-local sequential numbering by object type.
choices.evidence: source/locale/ar/open-logic-locale.sty: theorem=مبرهنة, example=مثال, definition=تعريف, proposition=قضية, problem=مسألة; source config text token proof=برهان; locale figure cref=شكل.
choices.rationale: Reflow has no stable PDF page numbers. Numbering gives each link a faithful named referent rather than labelling every figure/definition by the section title.
choices.limits: EPUB local numbering is not asserted to equal the complete printed reader's numbering; stable source-unit and label IDs preserve correspondence.

choices.choice: Convert each original TikZ path to the exact SVG path geometry; use the existing Arabic caption as the SVG accessible title.
choices.evidence: Frozen source/assets/diagrams/union.tikz, intersection.tikz, difference.tikz and the actual Arabic figure captions in unions-and-intersections.tex.
choices.rationale: No bitmap pages, guessed redrawing, or new translation. Cubic coordinates and closure are retained. Coordinate scale0.8pt is accounted for in stroke widths. Colors are presentation-only distinct dark blue/red/gray; source semantic color-role identities A/B/C are retained.
choices.limits: Caption-derived descriptions are not a complete spoken-mathematics accessibility edition. They add no claim of human-tested accessibility.

choices.choice: Select the source false branch for two forward references whose chapters are outside the standalone Sets package.
choices.evidence: Source oliflabeldef tests sfr:arith:real:realline and cumul:::part; the six-section chapter routing includes neither target chapter.
choices.rationale: Use the source's own standalone conditional behavior, not an invented dangling link. Both original true branches are preserved verbatim in the build crosswalk. Every unconditional sentence and all327 formulas remain.
choices.limits: This is explicitly a bounded chapter profile, not a byte-identical excerpt of the full722 PDF. Full-work EPUB conversion must re-evaluate conditional targets against its expanded scope.
